AC7 is MET: **local `make verify` — EXIT=0**, completed 2026-11-04 17:03:36 PST.

- Tree: branch `impl-e508` at `f50a0a410bc`, rebased onto `origin/main` `c790f07f0b2`.
- Log: `.rebar/worktrees/impl-e508/.rebar/scratch/e508-rebased-13542/verify.log`
- lint: `All checks passed!` (line 2)
- typecheck: `Success: no issues found in 757 source files` (line 88)
- bare-`pytest` import-convention guard: passed (line 91)
- test: **`20839 passed, 27 skipped, 19 warnings in 2895.25s (0:48:15)`** (line 475)
- final segment: `202 passed, 2 skipped in 206.92s` (line 483)
- `grep -c '^FAILED'` over the full log: **0**

**An earlier run on this change was red; it was not this change.** A first `make verify` exited 2 on exactly two tests — `test_cli_passed_but_unsigned_is_exit_11_with_byte_identical_stderr` and `test_cli_llm_error_is_clean_exit_one`. That is bug `cded-334b-a742-4082` (`bald-diagnostic-cricket`).

Verified rather than assumed, three ways: each test passes alone; the documented pair fails deterministically in ~7s with the `_seam.py:357` "authorship: signing SKIPPED" WARNING as the trigger; and this change's four files — `reviewers/code-review-tests.md`, `eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml`, `code_review/criteria_routing.json`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_evals.py` — are not in those tests' import graph.

The fix landed independently on `origin/main` as `a9300a8b2f2` ("Send rebar diagnostics to the process stderr"), adding `_ProcessStderrHandler`, which resolves `sys.__stderr__` at emit time instead of freezing the stream object at install. After rebasing onto a base containing it, the full suite is green.

Correcting an earlier attribution: I had ascribed those two failures to host contention from running verifies concurrently. That was wrong — they reproduce deterministically on an idle host in about 7 seconds. Contention explains the `f121-ed38` fetch-race failure, not this pair.

**Gerrit:** change 3329, revision `f50a0a410bc`, pushed 2026-11-04 17:0x PST. Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
